name: Graph-First Assets
description: Declare a list of assets from YAML with a no-op materialization body -- lineage, checks, freshness, and automation without real compute
author: Dagster Community

assets.label: Assets
assets.description: List of asset specs to declare. Each entry: `key` (required), plus optional `deps`, `group_name`, `description`, `kinds`, `owners`, `tags`, `metadata`, `code_version`, `skippable`, partition fields (`partition_type`/`partition_start`/`partition_values`/`dynamic_partition_name`), `automation_condition` ('eager'/'on_missing'/{kind: on_cron, cron_schedule}), `freshness_max_lag_minutes` + optional `freshness_cron`. Materializing one logs a line and returns MaterializeResult -- no data is read or written.
